messages:
matt_k: Cutting RC for the KV-cache regression fix. Candidate: rc-2026-03-20-42, artifact sha abc123def4. Need quick signoff for a narrow-window promo tonight.
emily_r: ack. What's the rollback plan if we see latency spike on small requests?
raj_patel: plan: canary 10% for 15m, then 50% for 20m, full. Rollback will flip traffic back to rc-previous and notify paging. KV warmup script included.
matt_k: pin request to prevent any auto-rollforward: `pin:rc-2026-03-20-42@artifact:abc123def4` — requesting ops pin for the change window 2026-03-20 00:00-04:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Candidate created: rc-2026-03-20-42 by matt_k. Actions available: promote, pin, abort. See /deploy help.
emily_r: QA notes: loadtest run on staging passed for median p50/p95. Small regression on p99 under 3% — acceptable. Added smoke prompts to release notes.
qa_bot: smoke-tests: all green. KV cache warm path exercised. Logs attached in test-run-9001.
sheriff_olga: I'll be sheriff for the window. If we see >5% error or >200ms p95 regression, we rollback immediately. Who's on-call for infra?
raj_patel: infra on-call is mike_ops tonight. I'll DM him now.
matt_k: Release notes draft:
```
- Fix: KV prefix caching caused occasional stale reads during compaction; fixed race in cache invalidation.
- Impact: reduced stale-read incidents; no expected downstream schema changes.
- Rollout: staged canary + traffic shift. Pin artifact during change window.
```
emily_r: Can we include the exact deploy commands for traceability?
matt_k: yes: `/deploy promote rc-2026-03-20-42 --canary=10%:15m,50%:20m --pin --notify=ops,qa,sheriff_olga` and `/deploy rollback rc-previous` as the rollback.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Preflight checks: artifact abc123def4 exists, integration tests passed, no open blocking PRs. Approvals: 1/2 (emily_r pending).
emily_r: approved. leaving a short comment in the PR.
matt_k: pinned the candidate in release manager UI. CI badge updated.
sheriff_olga: I'll be watching dashboards. If any spike, post in this thread and trigger rollback. Also tag incident if fallback needed.
raj_patel: noted. I've pasted Grafana links and the quick-runbook to this thread.
matt_k: scheduling promotion for 00:10 UTC, 2026-03-20 to avoid traffic peak. Any objections?
emily_r: no objections from QA side.
matt_k: final checklist:
- [x] Pin artifact
- [x] Preflight checks pass
- [x] QA smoke green
- [x] Sheriff + infra notified
- [ ] Promote at 00:10 UTC
- [ ] Monitor 35m then full cutover
raj_patel: I'm on standby for hotfix rollback steps. If we rollback, run:
```
/deploy rollback rc-2026-03-20-42 --reason="p95 regression" --notify=all
```
matt_k: when I run the promote I'll post deploy-bot output here.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion started: rc-2026-03-20-42 -> canary 10% (00:10 UTC). Tracking id: promo-3087654321-a
emily_r: seeing initial canary logs, p50 looks stable.
sheriff_olga: p95 drift +1.2% — still below threshold.
raj_patel: 10% check complete, promoting to 50%.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Traffic shifted to 50% (00:26 UTC). Observability: https://grafana.company/r/3087654321
matt_k: after 50m hold we're green, proceed to full.
emily_r: agree, go full when ready.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Full promotion complete (00:52 UTC). No errors reported in initial 10m window.
sheriff_olga: marking window clear in 30m if no regressions.
matt_k: updating release notes with final prod timestamp and linking changelog.
raj_patel: leaving post-deploy checklist: monitor 6h, run KV-stress every 2h, and set regression alert thresholds tighter for 24h.
matt_k: great — closing thread once QA completes 6h watch.
emily_r: closing: QA 6h check passed at 06:15 UTC. No regressions observed. :tada:
matt_k: thanks everyone. RC promoted and stable. Release notes pushed to docs.
